question: What immunity to poison is attained through the perfected practice described above?
premises: The practitioner may be bitten by great serpents
Poison would normally enter the body
In this case poison does not enter the body
inference: Through this perfected practice, poison does not enter the body even if one is bitten by great serpents.
plain_english: Poison does not enter the body, even if one is bitten by great serpents.
